hni_signals: STRONGEST HNI PROFILE IN THIS BATCH - combines department headship with a genuine multi-site private business. HOD / DEPARTMENT HEADSHIP: 'Senior consultant and head of the department of urology and renal transplant at CARE Hospitals, Banjara Hills'. RENAL TRANSPLANT is among the highest-value surgical service lines in Indian private healthcare. NATIONAL AWARD: titled 'INSPIRING UROLOGIST OF INDIA 2019' - attributed in published profiles to The Economic Times (one source instead credits it to Telangana State; the discrepancy is flagged rather than resolved). CAPITAL-INTENSIVE TECHNOLOGY: his clinic advertises a 150W thulium laser for prostate and a 100W holmium laser for kidney stones, plus robotic surgery - buying and running that equipment class implies substantial practice capital. INTERNATIONAL VENDOR CERTIFICATION: certification course in Robotic Surgery from Intuitive Surgical (USA), the da Vinci manufacturer. Both are recorded as published; neither is estimated or reconciled. ELITE TRAINING: MS from PGIMER Chandigarh and MCh Urology from BYL Nair, Mumbai. MEDIA PLATFORM: named contributor with author pages on Medical Dialogues (both medicaldialogues.in and health.medicaldialogues.in), plus an active clinic Facebook page. Full name published as Vamsi Krishna Poleboyina (the 'P' initial).
